t: A friendly desktop robot kit with a moving head, a camera and a voice.
steps: Order the Lite or Wireless kit from the Pollen Robotics store.
Set aside about two and a half hours to build the no-solder kit.
Follow the Reachy Mini getting started guide in the Hugging Face docs.
Install the Reachy Mini desktop app on your computer.
Connect the robot over USB-C or Wi-Fi and wake it up.
Run the conversation app and say hello.
Install the Python SDK and try a short script that tilts the head.
